messages:
anna-cs: heads up — putting together a short customer-facing runbook for smaller accounts (M/M SaaS) that covers prefetching, batch sizing, and when to recommend streaming. want to keep it simple for CSMs and enablement.
mike-se: love it. could we include a quick decision tree? e.g., when avg latency <150ms use batching; when user-facing chat require streaming.
sarah-impl: +1. can we also add a short checklist for onboarding sessions so CS knows what to validate live (prefetch warmup, sample prompts, perf smoke)?
lee-eng: adding a tiny config snippet we use in Dedicated for prefetch windows — can be copy/paste:
```
# prefetch config
prefetch.enabled=true
prefetch.window=30s  # keep KV cache warm for 30s after active session
batch.max_tokens=512
batch.max_wait=25ms
streaming.threshold_latency=120ms
```
mike-se: nice. can we also call out renewal risk signals? small accounts often slip because they never hit predictable cost -> usage patterns.
anna-cs: yes. proposed minimal renewal risk flags for CSMs to monitor:
- 30-day active users < 5 AND monthly requests < 10k => low adoption flag
- repeated cold starts (p95 latency spikes > 500ms) after onboarding => perf risk
- feedback channel marked "output variance" or "hallucination" > 3 tickets/month => quality risk
include recommended actions next to each flag (e.g., 1: schedule 30-min enablement; 2: enable prefetch + smaller batch; 3: capture failing prompts + eval)
jonathan-csm: can you add who owns each action? CSMs shouldn't be making infra changes. suggest: CSM action = enablement + prompts; ENG owner = prefetch/batching toggles; SE = config review.
anna-cs: agreed — i'll add owner columns. also adding a one-pager for internal handoff template:
"Customer Handoff: account, adoption flags, last enablement, perf notes, suggested config" (one paragraph per item)
mike-se: for public-facing guidance keep the wording non-technical: "We recommend enabling warmup for 30s and using streaming for live-chat flows." put deep config under an "Advanced" section.
sarah-impl: tagging @deploy-bot to run the smoke check on the prefetch template against sandbox so we can include live numbers.
deploy-bot: smoke-check started for sandbox-runbook-2026-03
deploy-bot: smoke-check results: median latency 98ms, p95 180ms, cache hit-rate 62% — prefetch window 30s looks reasonable in sandbox
anna-cs: perfect. i'll draft the short runbook and share a Google doc link here tomorrow. aim: one-page customer-facing + one internal checklist. target to roll to CSMs next Tue.
jonathan-csm: :thumbsup: assign to anna-cs and mike-se for final review. LMK if you need a quick review session.
anna-cs: thanks all — will ping when draft is ready :eyes:
